what: Labels on the stated reasons of the wrong-setup test of 2026-10-30.
judge: A judgement by one AI agent (Claude Opus 5.5). No second judge, no human check, no agreement figure.

blinding.method: Answers were shuffled under ids A001 to A039 with model names in a separate key. Labels were written and hashed before the key was opened.
limits: Before blinding, the model name and the first 40 characters of the reason of one row were seen (M1-inlet-speed step 6000, 12b).
One unlabelled answer (12b, M1-inlet-speed step 4500, consistent) was read when checking the file layout.
Repeated wording can hint that answers come from one model, without showing which.
The judge knew the run of each answer, which the question requires.
blinding.not_read: The builder's report tables and summaries. reasons-to-judge.jsonl was compared by script after the labels were fixed.

wrong_frames.question: Does the reason name the actual change or its direct visible effect?
wrong_frames.names_it: A ground for 'inconsistent' states the change or the listed effect: M1 speeds far too low; M2 smooth, steady, no vortices, thick boundary layers; M3 no boundary layer at the walls; M4 reverse flow along the top wall; M5 closed lower half, jet, different flow near the step. Other clauses may be wrong; those are in the note.
wrong_frames.partly: The reason holds a true observation caused by the change, or a phrase close to the listed effect, but its main ground is something else, or it gives the observation another cause.
wrong_frames.no: The reason rests on something else; nothing in it follows from the change.

normal_frames.question: Is the stated reason something that is really there?
normal_frames.names_it: The fault it states is really in the frame.
normal_frames.partly: Part of the fault it states is really in the frame.
normal_frames.no: The fault it states is not in the frame. True descriptive clauses are listed in the note.

label_rule.strict_reading: Counting only names_it as a hit moves all 17 partly answers to not named (M2 9, M5 8).

missing_step_ground.pattern: no (evidence of a )?backward-facing step|without the geometry of a backward-facing step

false_alarm_twins.note: For each inconsistent answer on a normal frame: what the same model answered on the near-identical state with a different title.

rows.twin_reason: The velocity magnitude shows a recirculation zone and shear layer consistent with a backward-facing step, and the maximum velocity is close to the specified 32.2 m/s.
The velocity magnitude shows a flow separation and recirculation zone at the bottom left, consistent with a backward-facing step, and the maximum velocity is near the intended 32.2 m/s.

one_number_comparison.rule: colour-bar maximum of |U| below 32.2 m/s (written after the answers were seen, as a comparison only)

measured_facts.source: fields.npz, readable-metadata.json and the PNGs under wrong-setup-test-20261030/frames; cell counts, not area weighted

step_lip_m.note: 32 % of the picture height, on the left edge; no cells at x < 0 below y = 0.0127

M4.note: Each entry is (step, mean |dU|/32.2, mean |d|U||/32.2). M4 frames differ from N5 less than the normal run N4 does.

M5.note: No jet at the step: the core profile is flat at about 17 m/s against 33 m/s in N5.

M1.note: Colour-bar maximum 11.6 to 13.6 m/s and median 4.7 to 5.3 m/s in the window, not 3 m/s, because the fastest motion is decaying reverse flow; 78 to 82 % of window cells have Ux < 0.

M2.note: Reverse flow in 43 to 45 % of window cells, so recirculation exists; what is absent is the vortices of the normal frames.

M3.note: Near-wall speed 14.7 to 16.7 m/s against 3.5 to 6.0 m/s in normal runs: the missing boundary layer is in the picture.

near_identical_states.N4 step 6500 and N5 step 4500: same flow state, largest difference in U 1.6e-4 m/s; the picture titles differ
near_identical_states.N4 step 7500 and N5 step 5500: same flow state, largest difference in U 2.5e-5 m/s; the picture titles differ

examples.rule: Per wrong run: inconsistent answers first, models taken in turn in the order 12b, 26b, 31b, qwen35-35b, earliest step first, skipping wording already taken (numbers ignored); then repeated wording; then, only when fewer than 5 inconsistent answers exist, consistent answers by the same rule, marked as such.
